description: This file defines a React component for a rich text editor toolbar, including formatting options, heading levels, block insertion, and inline marks, utilizing various UI components and Slate.js for editor state management.

methods.name: Toolbar
methods.description: Main React component rendering the editor toolbar with formatting options, heading levels, block insertion, and view toggle.

methods.name: HeadingMenu
methods.description: Component for selecting heading levels or paragraph formatting.

methods.name: InsertBlockMenu
methods.description: Component providing a menu to insert component blocks into the editor.

methods.name: InlineMarks
methods.description: Component for toggling inline text formatting marks such as bold, italic, underline, etc.

methods.name: useMemoStringified
methods.description: Hook to memoize values based on their JSON stringification.

methods.name: useEntryLayoutSplitPaneContext
methods.description: Hook placeholder for layout context, currently returns null.

methods.name: ToolbarContainer
methods.description: Layout container for toolbar content, adjusts styling based on layout context.

methods.name: ToolbarWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper component for the toolbar with styling and layout.
